title: ID0477108-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002644] Charging Phase "P04_PRE_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charging Phase "P04_PRE_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
Suspected root cause: EV, only this EV caused the sessions to fail, all the other sessions are working. In EcoG logs we see: decode_v2gExiDocument failed -10
Solution: EcoG sw related issue - fix is on its way - EV model and brand was requested but not given

additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good morning.
Laura's assessment was correct, the EVs couldn't charge due to an error in PreCharge phase.
I checked the Charging Controller logs and at the moment, the error seems to be from the EV, since after these failed attempts there were more sessions performed and worked well. Also, all the failed sessions are from the exact same EV, in both chargers.
Since both tickets are related to the same topic (ID0477108 and this one) I will merge them together and use one single ticket.
I will confirm this statement and come back to you.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
